rows.claim: Published request and agency response; not an appropriation or solicitation.
rows.explanation: Greatly increase the number of loading zones in commercial corridors with in CD1Q. Areas such as upper Steinway Street see immense double parking for commercial vehicles. Other areas within the district see a massive uptick in home delivery such as Ditmars Blvd. With apartments above the businesses these deliveries are a real impact. In adding commercial corridor loading zones it will reduce double parking allowing the passage of bicycles, cars, motorcycles and other trucks in a more efficient way lowering volume traffic delays. Additionally this change will provide safe roadways.
rows.headline: Improve traffic and pedestrian safety, including traffic calming
rows.response: OMB supports the agency's position as follows: Agency supports and can accommodate Explanation: DOT has installed over 500 new loading zones that address public feedback on where they commonly see double parking and blocked bike and bus lanes due to vehicle loading and unloading. In 2023, NYC DOT launched a new web platform where New Yorkers can report problem areas. Double-parking and blocked bike and bus lanes create safety hazards and contribute to traffic congestion. These efforts complement other recent and ongoing NYC DOT initiatives to reduce the negative impacts of truck deliveries and make deliveries safer and smoother for everyone. More info available here: https://www.nyc.gov/html/dot/html/pr2024/nyc-d ot-loading-zones.shtml
